mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Hidden Cave of the Silver-Tailed Fox
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: You find a moss-covered cave beneath an ancient cedar. Inside, a silver-tailed fox sleeps beside a jade chest.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Bandit Roadblock
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: Three ragged cultivators block the path, demanding spirit stones for passage.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Hidden Herb Garden
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A small clearing bathed in moonlight grows spirit herbs. Some are ready to harvest.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Abandoned Shrine
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A small shrine to a forgotten earth spirit offers a moment of peace. Qi flows gently here.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Wounded Traveler
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A young cultivator lies injured on the path, their leg caught in a beast trap. They beg for help.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Fox Spirit's Illusion
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: The path ahead shimmers. A fox spirit weaves illusion mist, trying to lead you into a bog.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Ancient Hunting Trap
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: You step on a hidden formation disk. Ropes of light spring up, attempting to bind your limbs.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Echo of the First Breath
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A breeze carries the faint sound of a single note — the first breath of a cultivator who passed through a century ago. The dao lingers.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Wandering Herb Farmer
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: An old cultivator tends a small plot of spirit herbs by the roadside. A pack of spirit wolves circles his cart.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Qi-Infused Strays
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: Three dogs with glowing eyes and crackling fur block the path. They were once pets of a cultivator who vanished.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Overturned Merchant Cart
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A merchant cart lies on its side, goods scattered across the mud. Something rustles inside the wreckage.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Discarded Training Ground
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A neglected training ground where straw dummies still stand. Faint qi lingers in the wooden frames.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Hidden Spirit Spring
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A spring of clear water bubbles from beneath a mossy stone. The water hums with wood-attribute qi.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Lost Traveler
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A young traveler sits by the path, weeping. They lost their way and their food days ago.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Fox Spirit's Riddle
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A silver fox blocks the path and speaks in a human tongue: 'Answer my riddle or turn back.'

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Mistwood Fox King
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A massive nine-tailed fox emerges from the mist, its eyes burning with ancient cunning. The source of the forest's disturbances.

bamboo_grove.title: Bamboo Serpent Ambush
bamboo_grove.text: A massive emerald serpent drops from the canopy, its scales humming with wood qi.

bamboo_grove.title: Sword-Scarred Bamboo
bamboo_grove.text: A grove of bamboo stalks bears deep cuts — sword intent frozen in the grain after a duel decades past.

choices.label: Match Your Blade to the Scar

bamboo_grove.title: Bamboo Spirit Glade
bamboo_grove.text: The bamboo parts to reveal a glade where motes of green qi drift lazily. A spirit of the grove regards you.

bamboo_grove.title: Wind-Whipped Rope Bridge
bamboo_grove.text: A fraying rope bridge stretches across a deep ravine. Wind howls through the gorge below.

bamboo_grove.title: Ancient Sword Hilt
bamboo_grove.text: Half-buried in bamboo roots, a sword hilt carved with cloud patterns catches your eye.

bamboo_grove.title: Wandering Merchant
bamboo_grove.text: A merchant cultivator sits by the path, their cart overturned. Spirit beasts circle nearby.

bamboo_grove.title: Bamboo Formation Trap
bamboo_grove.text: The bamboo shifts around you — someone set a trapping formation. Sharpened stakes spring from the earth.

choices.label: Wait for the Qi to Settle

bamboo_grove.title: Moonlight Pond
bamboo_grove.text: A still pond reflects the moon. The water hums with ambient qi, gentle and inviting.

bamboo_grove.title: Ghost Bamboo Flute
bamboo_grove.text: A haunting melody drifts through the stalks — a bamboo flute playing itself, left by a musician who died here decades ago.

bamboo_grove.title: Coiled Bamboo Python
bamboo_grove.text: A massive python, its scales patterned like bamboo leaves, coils around the trunk of an ancient tree. It watches you with unblinking eyes.

bamboo_grove.title: Fallen Swordsman
bamboo_grove.text: The bones of a swordsman rest against a bamboo stalk, a half-buried technique manual clutched in skeletal fingers.

bamboo_grove.title: Immortal Bamboo Shoots
bamboo_grove.text: A cluster of rare bamboo shoots glows faintly with wood qi. They take years to grow but are prized for pill refinement.

bamboo_grove.title: Spirit Monkey Troop
bamboo_grove.text: A troop of qi-infused monkeys drops from the canopy, pelting you with rocks and stealing anything shiny.

bamboo_grove.title: Wind Chime Grove
bamboo_grove.text: Bamboo chimes strung between the stalks create an eerie, disorienting melody. The sound seeps into your mind.

bamboo_grove.title: Smuggler's Cache
bamboo_grove.text: Behind a false wall of bamboo, someone stashed contraband — spirit stones, a locked chest, and a warning note.

bamboo_grove.title: Spirit of the Grove
bamboo_grove.text: The bamboo stalks part to reveal the grove's ancient spirit — a serpentine dragon made of living bamboo, its eyes ancient and wise.

ashen_cliff.title: Volcanic Herb Ledge
ashen_cliff.text: On a precarious ledge above molten rock, fire-adapted herbs glow with inner heat.

ashen_cliff.title: Fire Beast Lair
ashen_cliff.text: A cave mouth glows orange. Inside, a beast wreathed in embers gnaws on spirit ore.

choices.label: Lure It Out and Sneak In

ashen_cliff.title: Raiders' Outpost
ashen_cliff.text: A crude outpost blocks the cliff pass. Fire path raiders have claimed this territory.

ashen_cliff.title: Ash Spring
ashen_cliff.text: A hot spring steams amid black stone. The mineral-rich water carries fire qi.

ashen_cliff.title: Falling Boulders
ashen_cliff.text: The cliff path trembles. Loose boulders tumble from above, kicked loose by something larger.

ashen_cliff.title: Rogue Cultivator Ambush
ashen_cliff.text: A rogue cultivator steps from behind a pillar of ash, blade drawn. 'Your qi feels rich. Share it.'

ashen_cliff.title: Ancient Fire Formation
ashen_cliff.text: You step into a circle of black stone. Ember runes ignite — a meditation formation from a fire path elder long passed.

ashen_cliff.title: Ash Phantom
ashen_cliff.text: Ash swirls into a humanoid shape — the remnant of a cultivator who died here. It reaches for you.

ashen_cliff.title: Smoldering Fissure
ashen_cliff.text: A fissure in the rock leaks concentrated fire qi, creating shimmering heat waves. The energy could be harvested.

ashen_cliff.title: Raider Scout
ashen_cliff.text: A lone raider watches from a ridge, counting your moves. They signal to others further up the cliff.

ashen_cliff.title: Volcanic Vent Deposit
ashen_cliff.text: A volcanic vent has deposited rare fire-attributed minerals on the cliff face — fire obsidian and ember crystals.

ashen_cliff.title: Charred Temple Ruins
ashen_cliff.text: The ruins of a fire-cultivator temple, burned out long ago. Faint formation lines still glow in the ash.

ashen_cliff.title: Ash Viper Nest
ashen_cliff.text: A nest of vipers with scales like volcanic glass. They guard a rare fire herb growing in the warmth of their coils.

ashen_cliff.title: Lava Cascade
ashen_cliff.text: A beautiful cascade of molten rock flows down the cliff. The fire dao resonates in the flowing stone.

ashen_cliff.title: Smoke Binding Formation
ashen_cliff.text: A trap formation activates beneath you — smoke coalesces into binding chains, attempting to hold you in place.

ashen_cliff.title: Ancient Ember Turtle
ashen_cliff.text: The cliff trembles as a massive turtle wreathed in living flame crawls from a lava pool. Its shell bears ancient rune scars — a creature that has endured for centuries.

choices.label: It Is Ancient, Leave It Be

moonwell_ruins.title: Moonwell Reflecting Pool
moonwell_ruins.text: A basin of silver water reflects not your face, but a version of you from another life — one who chose differently.

moonwell_ruins.title: Ghost Sentry
moonwell_ruins.text: A translucent armored figure bars the entrance to a collapsed hall. It speaks: 'State your purpose.'

moonwell_ruins.title: Soul Treasure Chamber
moonwell_ruins.text: A sealed chamber hums with yin qi. Inside, jade slips and soul pearls rest on an altar.

moonwell_ruins.title: Crumbling Hallway
moonwell_ruins.text: The stone floor groans. Pressure plates from an ancient security system activate beneath your feet.

choices.label: Go Back and Find Another Path

moonwell_ruins.title: Moonlit Courtyard
moonwell_ruins.text: Moonlight pools in a ruined courtyard. The yin qi here is thick and soothing.

moonwell_ruins.title: Ghost Child
moonwell_ruins.text: A translucent child sits on a broken pillar, weeping. They were a disciple here, long ago.

choices.label: Demand to Know the Ruins' Secrets

moonwell_ruins.title: Yin Spring Vein
moonwell_ruins.text: A crack in the earth leaks concentrated yin qi, condensed into droplets of liquid moonlight.

moonwell_ruins.title: Formation Puzzle
moonwell_ruins.text: A circular formation of nine tiles blocks the path. Each tile bears a different moon phase.

moonwell_ruins.title: Spirit Will-o'-Wisp
moonwell_ruins.text: A pale blue wisp flickers before you, beckoning you deeper into the ruins. It may lead to treasure — or a trap.

moonwell_ruins.title: Animated Guardian Armor
moonwell_ruins.text: Rusted armor on a stand begins to move as you pass — a spirit-powered guardian still defending its post after centuries.

choices.label: Wait for Its Qi to Deplete

moonwell_ruins.title: Pool of Memories
moonwell_ruins.text: A still pool reflects not your face but a memory — the moment the ruins fell, centuries ago. The knowledge lingers.

moonwell_ruins.title: Sealed Sarcophagus
moonwell_ruins.text: A stone sarcophagus sits in an alcove, sealed with yin-attributed formations. Burial treasures may lie within.

moonwell_ruins.title: Moonstone Vein
moonwell_ruins.text: A vein of moonstone runs through the wall, glowing with concentrated yin qi. Precious and rare.

moonwell_ruins.title: Ghost Guard Patrol
moonwell_ruins.text: A patrol of translucent guards sweeps the hall, their formations tight and disciplined. One wrong move and they'll sound the alarm.

moonwell_ruins.title: Hidden Cultivator's Study
moonwell_ruins.text: Behind a false wall, an ancient cultivator's study remains untouched — jade slips, pill recipes, and a meditation cushion.

moonwell_ruins.title: Moonwell Construct
moonwell_ruins.text: At the heart of the ruins, a massive stone construct powered by yin qi blocks the way. Its eyes glow with ancient power — the final guardian of the Moonwell.

verdant_depths.title: Ancient Tree Guardian
verdant_depths.text: A massive ancient tree stirs. Its roots snake toward you as a face forms in the bark.

verdant_depths.title: Sunken Herb Garden
verdant_depths.text: A collapsed section of the forest floor reveals a garden of rare shade-grown herbs.

verdant_depths.title: Deep Forest Shrine
verdant_depths.text: A moss-covered shrine to the spirit of the deep woods offers shelter. The air is calm and safe.

verdant_depths.title: Silkweb Spider Ambush
verdant_depths.text: Sticky silk strands fall from the canopy. A massive spider descends, mandibles dripping with venom.

verdant_depths.title: Spirit Beast Tracks
verdant_depths.text: Fresh tracks in the mud — a large spirit beast passed through recently. The trail leads to a thicket.

verdant_depths.title: Poison Fog Valley
verdant_depths.text: A valley below is filled with pale green mist. Even from here, your lungs burn.

choices.label: Wait for the Wind to Shift

verdant_depths.title: Verdant Dao Resonance
verdant_depths.text: The forest hums. Every leaf trembles in harmony. A moment of profound connection to the wood dao.

choices.label: Open Your Heart to the Forest

verdant_depths.title: Hollow Tree Cache
verdant_depths.text: A colossal hollow tree contains a hidden cache — someone's long-abandoned storage.

verdant_depths.title: Spirit Venus Trap
verdant_depths.text: A massive carnivorous plant, its maw dripping with digestive qi, lunges at you with thorned vines.

verdant_depths.title: Spirit Bee Hive
verdant_depths.text: A massive hive of qi-infused bees hums in the hollow of an ancient tree. Rare honey glistens in the comb.

verdant_depths.title: Overgrown Statue
verdant_depths.text: A stone statue of an ancient cultivator, now covered in moss and vines. A faint dao resonance emanates from within.

verdant_depths.title: Hidden Root Tunnel
verdant_depths.text: A tunnel through massive roots leads to a hidden chamber. Something glints in the darkness.

verdant_depths.title: Corrupted Clearing
verdant_depths.text: A clearing pulses with demonic qi. The plants here have twisted into monstrous shapes, corrupted by dark energy.

verdant_depths.title: Hidden Healing Spring
verdant_depths.text: A spring of clear water bubbles from beneath mossy roots. The water carries potent wood-attribute healing qi.

verdant_depths.title: Young Treant Spirit
verdant_depths.text: A small treant sapling, barely alive, reaches out with trembling branches. It was wounded by corrupted beasts.

verdant_depths.title: Forest Colossus
verdant_depths.text: The trees themselves part to reveal the forest's ancient protector — a colossus of living wood, vines, and stone. Its voice shakes the ground.

cursed_swamp.title: Corpse Leech Pool
cursed_swamp.text: A stagnant pool writhes with corpse leeches, drawn by the heat of living qi.

cursed_swamp.title: Will-o'-Wisp
cursed_swamp.text: A blue flame dances ahead, leading deeper into the swamp. Following it may lead to treasure — or a bog grave.

cursed_swamp.title: Flooded Ruin
cursed_swamp.text: Half-submerged stone walls mark a forgotten shrine. Something glints beneath the dark water.

cursed_swamp.title: Swamp Gas Bog
cursed_swamp.text: Bubbles rise from the mud. The air is thick with flammable swamp gas — one wrong spark could end you.

choices.label: Dispel the Gas with Wind Qi
Go Back and Find Another Route

cursed_swamp.title: Cursed Altar
cursed_swamp.text: A bloodstained altar pulses with demonic qi. A sealed manual lies on it — but touching it will curse you.

choices.label: Leave Before the Curse Takes Hold

cursed_swamp.title: Bog Beast Lair
cursed_swamp.text: A mound of mud and reeds shifts. A bog beast rises, caked in centuries of swamp sediment.

cursed_swamp.title: Dry Mound Refuge
cursed_swamp.text: A rare patch of dry earth rises from the bog. A few stunted trees provide shade.

cursed_swamp.title: Swamp Dao Echo
cursed_swamp.text: A moment of stillness. The swamp's corruption and life force are one — a lesson in balance.

cursed_swamp.title: Soul Reed Field
cursed_swamp.text: Tall reeds whisper secrets of the dead — souls trapped between worlds. Their words carry fragments of lost knowledge.

choices.label: Try to Free the Trapped Souls

cursed_swamp.title: Giant Poison Toad
cursed_swamp.text: A massive toad erupts from the muck, its skin bubbling with lethal toxins. It swallows whole prey in one gulp.

cursed_swamp.title: Ruined Pill Refinery
cursed_swamp.text: Half-submerged in the swamp, a ruined pill refinery still holds sealed pills in its underwater storage.

cursed_swamp.title: Withered Cultivator
cursed_swamp.text: A dying cultivator, their body consumed by swamp corruption, reaches out a trembling hand. 'Save me... or take what I have left.'

cursed_swamp.title: Bog Light Maze
cursed_swamp.text: Misleading lights dance across the bog, creating a shifting maze. Following them leads deeper — but never forward.

cursed_swamp.title: Carrion Bird Swarm
cursed_swamp.text: A flock of swamp carrion birds, their eyes red with qi, descends from the grey sky. They smell the living.

cursed_swamp.title: Miasma Pocket
cursed_swamp.text: A pocket of dense, toxic miasma hangs in the air — invisible until your lungs begin to burn.

choices.label: Wait for the Wind to Shift

cursed_swamp.title: Bog Wyrm
cursed_swamp.text: The swamp erupts as a massive wyrm — part serpent, part earth dragon — rises from the depths. Its body is armored in centuries of hardened mud and corruption.

choices.label: Lull It to Sleep with Qi

sword_tomb.title: Sword Guardian Spirit
sword_tomb.text: A spirit clad in rusted armor rises, gripping a broken blade. It challenges all who enter.

sword_tomb.title: Field of Broken Blades
sword_tomb.text: Hundreds of shattered swords jut from the earth. Sword intent lingers in each fragment.

sword_tomb.title: Sword Tomb Rest Chamber
sword_tomb.text: An intact chamber with a stone bed and a quiet fountain. Ancient duelists once rested here.

sword_tomb.title: Falling Swords Trap
sword_tomb.text: You trigger a pressure plate. Ancient mechanisms release a volley of rusted blades from the ceiling.

sword_tomb.title: Sword Technique Stele
sword_tomb.text: A black stone stele bears the carving of a single sword stance. The intent radiates like heat.

sword_tomb.title: Ghost Duelist
sword_tomb.text: A translucent swordsman blocks your path. They were a tomb guardian in life and still guard their post.

sword_tomb.title: Tomb Armory
sword_tomb.text: A collapsed armory contains rusted but salvageable weapons and armor.

sword_tomb.title: Sword Intent Corridor
sword_tomb.text: A long corridor lined with sword marks. Each step intensifies the pressure of lingering sword intent.

choices.label: Turn Back and Find Another Path

sword_tomb.title: Swordsman's Epitaph
sword_tomb.text: A stone epitaph bears the final words of a legendary swordsman: 'The blade that cuts nothing cuts deepest.' Sword intent lingers in the carving.

sword_tomb.title: Blade Shard Storm
sword_tomb.text: Your footstep triggers an ancient mechanism — shards of rusted blades swirl through the air like a deadly wind.

choices.label: Wait for the Storm to Pass

sword_tomb.title: Ancient Dueling Platform
sword_tomb.text: A raised stone platform bears countless sword scars. A ghost duelist materializes, blade drawn, challenging you to a formal duel.

sword_tomb.title: Sword Manual Fragment
sword_tomb.text: Half of a sword manual, its pages preserved by qi, lies in a crack between stones. The other half is missing.

sword_tomb.title: Blade of Resentment
sword_tomb.text: A sword embedded in the wall pulses with dark qi — the spirit of its last wielder, consumed by bloodlust, still clings to it.

sword_tomb.title: Ancient Sword Forge
sword_tomb.text: A dormant forge where tomb guardians once repaired their blades. Half-finished swords still rest on the anvil.

sword_tomb.title: Echo of a Past Duel
sword_tomb.text: The air shimmers as the echo of a centuries-old sword duel plays out before you — two phantom bladesmen trading strikes.

sword_tomb.title: Sword Tomb Overlord
sword_tomb.text: At the deepest chamber, the overlord of the sword spirits waits — a towering spectral figure wielding seven phantom blades, each humming with killing intent.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Unstable Qi Vein
spirit_vein_mine.text: The ground hums with raw qi. A cracked spirit vein pulses erratically — one wrong step could trigger a burst.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Earth Beast Tunnel
spirit_vein_mine.text: A grinding sound echoes from a side tunnel. An earth beast with crystal hide blocks the way.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Rich Spirit Stone Deposit
spirit_vein_mine.text: A wall of crystalline spirit stones, pure and dense. A fortune in raw stone.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Runaway Mine Cart
spirit_vein_mine.text: A mine cart loaded with ore breaks loose on the tracks, hurtling toward you.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Collapsed Shaft
spirit_vein_mine.text: The tunnel ahead has collapsed. The ceiling groans — more may fall.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Hidden Miner's Cavern
spirit_vein_mine.text: An abandoned miner's break room, still stocked with dried rations and a jug of water.

choices.label: Take What's Useful and Move On

spirit_vein_mine.title: Underground River
spirit_vein_mine.text: An underground river blocks the deepest tunnel. The current is strong but the water glows with qi.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Earth Vein Dao Resonance
spirit_vein_mine.text: Deep in the mine, you feel the pulse of the earth vein itself — the dao of patience and pressure.

choices.label: Merge Your Qi with the Vein

spirit_vein_mine.title: Ghost of a Miner
spirit_vein_mine.text: A translucent miner swings a pickaxe at empty rock, still mining even in death. They notice you and stop.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Crystal Beetle Swarm
spirit_vein_mine.text: A swarm of beetles with crystal shells scuttles across the tunnel floor, drawn to the qi in your body.

spirit_vein_mine.title: New Shaft Discovery
spirit_vein_mine.text: A freshly collapsed wall reveals a new shaft — untouched and glistening with unmined spirit stone.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Miner's Tool Cache
spirit_vein_mine.text: A well-preserved cache of mining tools — some enchanted, all functional. A prospector's legacy.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Qi Crystal Grove
spirit_vein_mine.text: Deep in the mine, crystals have grown into a grove formation, each humming with concentrated earth qi.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Tunnel Collapse Trap
spirit_vein_mine.text: The ground gives way beneath you — an old support beam snaps, bringing down a shower of rock and dust.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Earth Spirit's Petition
spirit_vein_mine.text: The ground shifts and a face forms in the stone wall — the earth spirit of this mine. It asks: 'Why do you disturb my rest?'

spirit_vein_mine.title: Crystal Golem
spirit_vein_mine.text: The deepest chamber holds the mine's guardian — a golem of living spirit crystal, its body dense with centuries of compressed qi. It rises to defend its treasure.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Lotus Spirit
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A lotus spirit rises from the water, its petals sharp as blades. It guards the heart of the lake.

choices.label: Offer a Drop of Blood Qi

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Illusion Mist Shore
crimson_lotus_lake.text: Pink mist rolls across the shore. Visions of desire and fear flicker within — the lake testing your heart.

choices.label: Close Your Eyes and Walk Blind

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Blood Moon Altar
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A stone altar sits on a small island, bathed in crimson moonlight. Ancient symbols pulse with power.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Crimson Herb Garden
crimson_lotus_lake.text: Beneath the lake's surface, luminous crimson herbs grow in beds of volcanic sand.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Fire and Water Geyser
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A geyser of steam and fire qi erupts periodically. The ground is cracked and unstable.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Lake Islet
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A small islet rises from the lake, covered in soft moss. The mingled fire and water qi here is surprisingly harmonious.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Drowned Cultivator's Remains
crimson_lotus_lake.text: The bones of a cultivator rest at the lake bottom, their storage ring still intact.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Lotus Dance
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A group of lake spirits dance on the water's surface. They beckon you to join — but the dance is a test.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Blood Lotus Bloom
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A rare blood lotus blooms at the lake's surface, its petals pulsing with concentrated fire-water qi. The most prized herb in the region.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Water Phantom
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A translucent figure rises from the lake, its form shifting like water. It reaches for your qi with grasping tendrils.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Crimson Fog Bank
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A bank of crimson fog rolls across the lake shore. Within it, voices whisper of forgotten techniques and lost treasures.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Sunken Armory
crimson_lotus_lake.text: Stone walls rise from the lake bed — a submerged armory, its weapons still water-tight in sealed cases.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Lotus Wisdom Trial
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A lotus spirit manifests and poses a question of cultivation: 'What is the true nature of strength?'

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Blood Snail Swarm
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A swarm of parasitic blood snails slithers across the rocks, drawn to the warmth of your living qi.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Mirror of Inner Demons
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A perfectly still pool of water reflects not your face, but your inner self — your doubts, fears, and hidden ambitions made manifest.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Queen of the Crimson Lotus
crimson_lotus_lake.text: At the heart of the lake, the queen of all lotus spirits manifests — a towering figure of fire and water, petals the size of swords, eyes burning with ancient power.

heavenfall_peak.title: Lightning Beast
heavenfall_peak.text: A beast crackling with lightning energy prowls the peak. Its eyes glow with heavenly tribulation fire.

heavenfall_peak.title: Heavenly Pressure Field
heavenfall_peak.text: An invisible pressure crushes down — remnant heavenly tribulation energy. Every step is a battle.

choices.label: Find the Calm Eye of the Field

heavenfall_peak.title: Fallen Dao Mark
heavenfall_peak.text: A cracked boulder bears the palm print of a cultivator who attempted heavenly tribulation here — and failed. Their dao lingers.

heavenfall_peak.title: Heavenfall Cache
heavenfall_peak.text: Wedged in a cliff crevice, a sealed chest bears the mark of a heaven-defying cultivator.

heavenfall_peak.title: Lightning Storm Shelter
heavenfall_peak.text: A cave behind a waterfall offers shelter from the lightning storm raging above.

heavenfall_peak.title: Heavenly Thunder Echo
heavenfall_peak.text: Thunder rolls across the peak. Each peal carries a fragment of heavenly law — if you can understand it.

heavenfall_peak.title: Cliffside Path
heavenfall_peak.text: The only path forward is a narrow ledge along a sheer cliff. Wind howls, threatening to throw you off.

heavenfall_peak.title: Echo of a Heaven-Defier
heavenfall_peak.text: A spectral figure stands atop the peak — the echo of a cultivator who reached for immortality and was struck down. It turns to face you.

heavenfall_peak.title: Tribulation Remnant
heavenfall_peak.text: The air crackles with residual lightning. A cultivator's failed tribulation scarred the rock — their final moment frozen in time.

heavenfall_peak.title: Wind and Lightning Wraith
heavenfall_peak.text: A wraith of howling wind and crackling lightning bars the path. It was once a cultivator who perished in tribulation here.

heavenfall_peak.title: Heavenly Law Inscription
heavenfall_peak.text: Carved into the cliff face by lightning itself, ancient characters pulse with heavenly law — a fragment of the dao of heaven.

heavenfall_peak.title: Storm Hermit
heavenfall_peak.text: An old cultivator sits in the open, meditating as lightning strikes around them. They open one eye as you approach.

heavenfall_peak.title: Lightning-Struck Tree
heavenfall_peak.text: A massive tree, split by lightning, still crackles with residual energy. Inside the split trunk, something glows.

heavenfall_peak.title: Pressure Crystal Cave
heavenfall_peak.text: A cave where heavenly pressure has crystallized into rare pressure crystals — immensely valuable for body cultivation.

heavenfall_peak.title: Peak Threshold Trial
heavenfall_peak.text: A formation blocks the final approach — it tests whether you are worthy of the peak. Lightning arcs between the pillars.

heavenfall_peak.title: Heavenly Thunder Manifest
heavenfall_peak.text: At the very peak, the storm condenses into a living manifestation of heavenly thunder — a being of pure tribulation energy, ancient and terrible.
